??? quote "Dialogue"

    - Ah, *Player*! Pull up a chair. I have the best chair in the highlands, and I sell a fine one too. The Trading Post: where lowland goods meet highland ones, and everybody haggles.
    - The Canyon Road's clearer, and last week's caravan came in only two days late instead of five. Two days! I nearly hugged the mule.
    - The Fairy Forest traders came through the Young Woods without a scratch. Lantern oil, honey and gossip, all three at fair prices.
    - Vosk got his cable and sent back word that the twist was too loose. That's Vosk for thank you. I'll take it.
    - What'll it be?
        - *Choice:* Let me see your goods.
        - *Choice:* Who are you?
        - *Choice:* How are the caravans?
        - *Choice:* Who lodges upstairs?
        - *Choice:* Goodbye.
    - Potions, scrolls, cures, and the finest chair this side of the canyons. Take your time.
    - Corwell, keeper of the Trading Post. I came up the canyon with a trade caravan twenty years ago, was given water and a place by a Tolmach fire, and never went home. A lowlander who learned to love highland cheese. Don't tell Harra.
    - They come later every month, or not at all. The roads are rougher than they were, and lowland traders are a nervous lot. Ennek brings in whoever he can. I keep the shelves full and try not to worry where anyone can see.
    - Imre has the narrow room above my storeroom and pays half the rent in star charts. I've pinned every one behind the counter; customers ask about them more than the goods. Imre forgot supper again last night, so I left some on the stair.
    - Come back soon. The chair misses you.
